properties.title: Satellite sea surface temperature, Barkley Sound
properties.flag_note: Features with flagged=true are water not reachable from the open Pacific across this grid (Strait of Georgia, behind Vancouver Island). Render them muted, not hidden.
properties.geometry_note: Cells are clipped to the coastline from a 0.01 degree land mask. The VALUE is still a 5 km measurement.
properties.source_caveat: Near-real-time L4 analysis, about two days behind. Every step is labelled 'final' because the product publishes once -- that is not a quality tier.
